newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life restructures non-life area.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life restructures non-life area.

text.p: Life insurer Swiss Life said it was strengthening its domestic non-life cooperation with subsidiary La Suisse and breaking a cooperation pact for the same business with Schweizerishe Mobiliar Versicherungsgesellschaft.

Swiss Life said in a statement it would end its 25-year pact with cooperative Mobiliar as of January 1 and put La Suisse in charge of providing Swiss automobile, household, accident, health property damage and personal liability products.
La Suisse has belonged to Swiss Life since 1988 and had a strong presence in Swiss domestic life and non-life businesss.
"Swiss Life has decided to concentrate its non-life business at its subsidiary. This agreement strengthens and expands the non-life business of La Suisse," a Swiss Life spokeswoman told Reuters.
